title: Favorite trumpet players: Alcorn, Blakeney and Teddy Buckner
summary: Garland names Alvin Alcorn, Blakeney and Teddy Buckner, whom he brought into the Ory band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: That's great. What we've been doing is sort of talk about some of the instruments that you've enjoyed working with and some of the players, let's continue it if it's all right with you. What were the trumpet players that you enjoyed playing with the most? What trumpet player?
Alvin Alcorn.
Alvin Alcorn. Now he's not very well known out of New Orleans.
He's in New Orleans. Wonderful player.
Yes.
And the Blakeney's a wonderful player. I like to play with him. Teddy Buckner --
Teddy Buckner, that's right. Is Teddy Buckner originally from New Orleans, or --
No. No, I think, Buckner, I think down in Texas is his home. Somewhere in Texas.
He's been in L.A. so long.
He's been out here, he used to go to
school out here.
I see, I see.
I got him to come in the Ory band, little fellow.
He sounds like he listened to was with Louis Armstrong a whole lot.
Huh?
Buckner sounds like he was with Louis Armstrong a whole lot.
Well he is picking on up on his stuff, you know.
Yeah. Uh-huh.
He even sing like him. They all try to copy -- I'll be singing next week like him.
VOICE 2: "Daher on the Floor"
